issues.description: The master first changes into a relative data directory and then calls four do-files by relative name, while the package stores all five scripts under Codes for JAR. A separate staged working tree needs a coherent root, data subdirectory and output/TNIC directories.

Required handoffs still lack verified field/history/producer contracts: the CommonAlliance pair/date population, prepared FUNDA and company-pair-year panels, separate CIK/GVKEY and GVKEY/year/PERMNO links, AA.dta office data, official-kappas.dta, InstOwn_Perc.dta and innovation_value_to_merge.dta. PatentsView citation/application fields, inventor data and exact TNIC annual score files also remain unresolved. The raw DET_EPSUS and audit-opinion components are supported; their separate prepared link/office dependencies remain distinct. Source2's PatentsView filing_date comes from g_application.dta; its date encoding remains a separate unresolved contract and is not supplied by the KPSS README.

Stata itself and core estimation/table tools are available, but active calls to fsum, rangejoin, gduplicates, gegen, groups and winsor2 are not found in the checked adopaths; they need a supported ado setup before a run.
